pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding to losing positions; multi-entry scaling is banned unless the initial position is already at break-even + 1R profit.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order execution allowed within 15 minutes of high-impact macroeconomic news releases and when micro-volatility exceeds 2.5x the 20-period ATR.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stops once floating profit reaches $12, securing a mandatory minimum $15-$30 payout on winning runs.
